meta.note: 'effects' map a trait id to a weight (0-1). A statement answer multiplies the weight by the scale value. A scenario answer applies the chosen option's weights.

strandQuestion.text: Which Senior High School strand are you in (or did you take)?

questions.text: I enjoy solving math problems.
I can explain my ideas clearly when I speak or write.
I enjoy science experiments and learning how nature works.
I know my way around computers, apps, and the internet very well.

Look for software errors and settings
Organize everyone so the event can still go on
